entry.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
entry.note: Retired by AWS. The last day to take the exam was March 31, 2026; AWS states that holders keep an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned. AWS now points candidates to the Machine Learning Engineer Associate
entry.renewal: Retired; existing holders active 3 years from date earned

covers: architecting ML and deep learning workloads
reading.format: Exam-based certification; recertification by retaking the exam.
reading.status: Retiring; can still recertify by retaking the exam on or before March 31, 2026.
reading.summary: This certification validates expertise in building and deploying machine learning solutions on AWS Cloud. It shows ability to architect machine learning and deep learning workloads, optimize model training, and implement production-ready systems following AWS best practices. The exam also covers designing, building, deploying, optimizing, training, tuning, and maintaining ML solutions for business problems.
reading.audience: The page says the ideal candidate has two or more years of experience developing, architecting, and running machine learning or deep learning workloads in AWS Cloud. It is intended for people in AI and ML development or data science roles.
reading.validity: Certification remains active for 3 years from the date it was earned. Recertification is by retaking the exam; for current holders, the exam can be retaken on or before March 31, 2026.
reading.prerequisites: No specific certifications are required. The page states the ideal candidate has two or more years of experience developing, architecting, and running ML or deep learning workloads in AWS Cloud. Candidates commonly earn AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate, or AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate before attempting this certification.
